summary.notes: Single survivor was LibLeakyBucketCheckpoint.fillableAt, never exercised with a stored checkpoint differing from the queried clock; the one embedding test reaching it calls it in the same second as the mint, where the substitution is a no-op. Behaviour correct as written, so closed by strengthening testPackedReadsMatchCore in place plus a concrete-second case. Both adversarial findings are in the packed codec and neither is reachable through a monotonic block.timestamp: #1 is a write-path violation of the documented 'never hands out more headroom than reality' property (a timestamp behind the stored checkpoint regresses it; measured 501 units of headroom where 1 was earned), #2 is headroomAt/fillableAt disagreeing with fill when capacity exceeds LEAKY_BUCKET_LEVEL_MAX (fails closed, wrong error). publishedTag is null: nothing is published yet, the next-v0.1.0 tag is an unconsumed version seed and the Soldeer project does not exist. testsAfterCommit is the head of the coverage branch, pending merge of PR #3.
